components.caption: A type ramp read from MaterialTheme.typography — Confetti's ship stack, Roboto Flex (display/title) + Inter (body/label).
Colour-role swatches read from MaterialTheme.colorScheme.
Stock Confetti Wear theme — colour roles, surface ramp and type ramp. The look for any conference without a curated identity.
KotlinConf — JetBrains purple seed, JetBrains Mono display/title.
AndroidMakers — Parisian ochre seed.
Droidcon — Droidcon green seed.
DevFest — Google blue seed, Google Sans Flex throughout.
Session TitleCard — title, speakers, room and time.
Speaker chip with avatar, name and tagline.
Inline list section divider in the theme's primary accent.
Top-of-screen title (ListHeader).
Shimmering placeholder chip shown while content loads.
Tappable social-link icon (ImageVector overload).
Conference-day selector button.
Home screen — conference title, bookmarks and day list.
Sessions schedule list grouped by start time.
Session details — title, time, description and speakers.
Speaker details — photo, name, tagline and bio.
Bookmarks screen — upcoming and past bookmarked sessions.
Conference picker list.
Settings screen.
